shaderCode: vec3 a=vec3(1,0,0),q,p=u_cameraPosition;vec2 centered_uv=FC.xy*2.-r;float rollAngle=u_cameraRoll;mat2 rollMat=mat2(cos(rollAngle),-sin(rollAngle),sin(rollAngle),cos(rollAngle));centered_uv=rollMat*centered_uv;vec3 v=vec3(centered_uv/slider_zoom,r.y);v=rotate3D(u_cameraRotation.y,a.yxy)*v;vec3 camRight=normalize(cross(a.yxy,v));v=rotate3D(slider_cameraXRotation+u_cameraRotation.x,camRight)*v;vec3 rd=normalize(v);float glow=0.0;for(float d,i,l;l++<slider_maxIterations;p-=rd*d){q=p;d=-q.y-1.5;d+=sin(q.x*.2+t*.1)*cos(q.z*.2)*.5;for(i=1.;i<4.;i++){q=abs(q)-vec3(1.2,1.8,1.2)*slider_fractalScale;q.xz*=rotate3D(slider_fractalRotation,a.yxy).xy;q.xy*=rotate3D(slider_fractalRotation*.5,a.zzx).xy;d=min(d,length(q.xz)-.1*i);}if(d<0.001){vec3 n=normalize(vec3(0.1));vec3 col=mix(vec3(0.1,0.5,0.2),vec3(0.9,0.8,0.2),clamp(p.y*0.5+0.5,0.,1.));col=mix(col,vec3(1.,1.,0.9),slider_goldAmount*pow(max(0.,dot(reflect(rd,n),vec3(0,1,0))),5.));o.rgb=col*slider_brightness;break;}glow+=exp(-d*10.0)*slider_radiance;if(l>110.) {o.rgb+=glow*vec3(0.4,0.8,1.0);break;}}vec3 sunDir=normalize(vec3(0.2,slider_sunElevation,1.));float sunDot=max(0.,dot(rd,sunDir));vec3 sky=mix(vec3(0.2,0.6,1.0),vec3(1.0,1.0,0.8),pow(sunDot,2.0));sky+=vec3(1.0,0.9,0.7)*pow(sunDot,20.0);float dist=length(u_cameraPosition-p);float fog=1.-exp(-dist*slider_atmosphereDensity*.01);o.rgb=mix(o.rgb,sky*slider_brightness,fog);o.rgb+=vec3(1.0,0.9,0.5)*smoothstep(.99,1.,sunDot)*15.*slider_brightness;o.rgb+=vec3(0.2,1.0,0.5)*glow*0.02;

sliders.name: Celestial Zoom
sliders.description: Adjusts the field of view. Lower values bring the divine structures closer.

sliders.name: Garden Complexity
sliders.description: Controls the density and folding of the emerald landscapes.

sliders.name: Divine Geometry
sliders.description: Rotates the underlying crystalline structures of the world.

sliders.name: Radiance
sliders.description: Controls the intensity of the atmospheric glow and divine light.

sliders.name: Gold Purity
sliders.description: Determines the prominence of golden reflections on surfaces.

sliders.name: Sun Elevation
sliders.description: Positions the eternal sun. High values create a brilliant day, low values a golden twilight.

sliders.name: Divine Brightness
sliders.description: Overall luminosity of the heavenly realm.

sliders.name: Atmospheric Veil
sliders.description: Controls the depth of the glowing mist between the gardens.

sliders.name: Max Detail
